# QuietYieldGroup Guides

> Plain-English checklists, templates and calculators for Australian small businesses (allied health practices, trades, cleaning businesses, businesses paying contractors). Built from official sources and dated. General information, not advice. Publisher: QuietYieldGroup.

## Products
- [Get Paid From Day One: Allied Health Practice Setup Checklist (Australia)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-health-setup/): The registration and setup checklist for a new Australian allied health practice. 2026 edition, current as of 17 November 2026. A$29. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-health-setup/free-preview.pdf
- [Winning Council and Government Work in Queensland: Small Trade Firm Guide](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/qld-tenders-guide/): Where Queensland public jobs are listed, how council quotes work, and how to get onto panels (2026 edition) A$24. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/qld-tenders-guide/free-preview.pdf
- [Australian Cleaning Business Pricing Kit FY2026-27 | Award Rate Calculator](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/cleaning-kit/): Price domestic, end-of-lease and office cleans from the 1 July 2026 Cleaning Services Award rates, 12% super and GST: Excel calculator, quote template and checklists. A$35. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/cleaning-kit/free-preview.pdf
- [TPAR Contractor Payments Tracker – Australia 2026-27 (Excel + Guide)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/tpar-tracker/): Record contractor payments through the year in the form the ATO's Taxable payments annual report asks for, with a whole-dollar total for each contractor. A$15. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/tpar-tracker/free-preview.pdf
- [Capability Statement Template Australia: Word Kit for Trades (2026)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/capability-kit/): Editable one- and two-page Word template, a short guide and three filled-in examples for council, government and commercial work A$15. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/capability-kit/free-preview.pdf
- [Allied Health Practice Compliance Calendar 2026-27 (Australia)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-renewals/): A printable year planner and spreadsheet tracker for the renewals, registrations and recurring dates a small allied health practice has to keep current. A$12. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-renewals/free-preview.pdf

- [Cleaning Services Award 2026 Rates: How Much to Charge](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/cleaning-award-rates-pricing/): Cleaning Services Award 2026 hourly rates, the true cost of a cleaning hour, and a worked example of how much to charge per hour in Australia.
- [Medicare Provider Number for Allied Health: 2026 Checklist](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/medicare-provider-number-checklist/): How to get a Medicare provider number for allied health: PRODA and HPOS steps, the 28-day wait, and the address traps that delay applications.
- [Queensland Council Quote Thresholds 2026: How Small Firms Win](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/qld-council-quote-thresholds/): Queensland council quote thresholds after 1 July 2026 ($21,900 and $292,000 ex GST), and how small businesses get invited to quote on council work.

- [How Much to Charge for End of Lease Cleaning in Australia](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/end-of-lease-cleaning-price/): Work out an end of lease cleaning price from your own costs: hours, award rates, super, travel, overheads, margin and GST, plus what the job covers.
- [Health Fund Provider Registration: Bupa, HCF, HBF and More](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/health-fund-provider-registration/): How allied health providers get recognised by health funds: which take your details from Medicare, which need a form, and setting up HICAPS.
- [Ahpra Renewal Date 2026: Allied Health Registration Guide](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/allied-health-registration-renewals/): Ahpra renewal date for physio, psychology, OT, podiatry, chiro and osteo: 30 November, the December late period, fast-track and what you declare.
- [What to Include in a Capability Statement, With Examples](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/capability-statement-examples/): What to include in a capability statement, section by section, what to leave out, and three short examples for small trade and service firms.
- [TPAR Due Date 2026: Who Needs to Lodge a TPAR](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/tpar-due-date-who-lodges/): TPAR due dates for 2025-26 and 2026-27, who needs to lodge a taxable payments annual report for contractors, and what goes in it.
- [How to Quote Office Cleaning per Square Metre in Australia](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/office-cleaning-price-per-square-metre/): Quote office cleaning per square metre from your own costs: cleaning rate, award minimum shifts, shift rates, GST and a worked 400 m² example.
- [Payday Super 2026: Super Within 7 Business Days of Payday](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/payday-super-small-practice/): Payday Super for small allied health practices: super for each payday, received by the fund within 7 business days, at 12%, and the dates around it.
- [Public Liability Insurance for Council Contracts in Queensland](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/articles/public-liability-for-council-contracts/): How much public liability council and Queensland Government work asks for: the $20M Local Buy and $5M electrical minimums, and what to have ready.
